d:
The mastermind behind iconic songs like Kuch Kuch Hota Hai and Zara Zara Behakta Hai, Sameer Anjaan, joins us for an exclusive interview of Guest in the Newsroom! He shares unheard stories about Bollywood’s biggest stars and his journey in the music industry.
• What was it like working with Karan Johar on song lyrics?
• Memorable moments with Amitabh Bachchan & Shah Rukh Khan?
• His thoughts on the evolution and challenges of the music industry
